raw:
This is a systematic review and meta-analysis of general-purpose LLMs in dermatology. RAG is mentioned only as one finding among many. The paper is a review, so it falls under E2. Re-evaluating previously tested benchmarks is a possible exception, but it covers general LLMs rather than a RAG method, so it does not change the decision.

{"decision":"EXCLUDE","code":"E2","reason":"Systematic review/meta-analysis of LLMs in dermatology; not a RAG method with new RAG experiments."}
